instruction: Google Drive character canon is authoritative. The primary protagonist is Cao Minh / Vạn Giới Ma Tôn R15. The legacy internal key `kai` is retained only for save/runtime compatibility and must never be exposed as Cao Minh's identity. KNOWLEDGE_LOCK is backstage knowledge only; OPEN/UNKNOWN fields remain unresolved. Gameplay projection values are internal mechanics and must not be turned into cultivation lore, energy limits or dialogue terminology.

kai.name: Cao Minh / Vạn Giới Ma Tôn
kai.runtime: Cao Minh is Vạn Giới Ma Tôn, a Ma Đạo Kiếm Tu and the strongest known cultivator of his original world before falling into Backrooms. He belongs to no sect, empire or organization. The original world's name, historical era and detailed cultivation-realm system remain OPEN. He is confident but not blindly arrogant; relaxed, lazy, wine-loving and sarcastic outside serious danger, and reacts quickly and precisely when danger becomes real. He does not intentionally harm innocents and does not use righteous/demonic labels as a substitute for judgment.
kai.knowledgeLock: Backstage canon: Cao Minh is half-human/half-demon and inherits an ancient lineage linked to Vạn Quỷ Ma Tôn. Vạn Quỷ Ma Tôn is the inheritance source, not Cao Minh's title. Other characters may not infer this full origin merely from demonic energy, Huyết Ma Kiếm, Vạn Quỷ Ma Thân or regeneration.
kai.visual: R15: apparent male around thirty, true age unknown; very long thick black hair in a high ponytail, dark-red eyes and exposed face. Huyết Ma Chiến Khải is black-red bound armor with blood-red demonic inscriptions. Huyết Ma Kiếm is a large straight broad black greatsword with red blood inscriptions and a Ma Luân around the red crystal at the guard; it can hover and move under divine-sense control.
kai.abilities: Cao Minh has extremely high sword sense and divine sense. Vạn Quỷ Ma Tâm is his Đạo Cơ, Ma Hải and central origin, supplying a vast ma-nguyên source with no canonically locked intrinsic ceiling, enhancing body/reflex/perception/divine sense/regeneration and nourishing bound artifacts. Vạn Quỷ Ma Thân is full release of that origin and does not inherently remove control, impose a duration cap, cause corruption or backlash. Huyết Ma Nhị Thập Tứ Trảm stops external time completely and performs exactly 24 strikes before time resumes.
kai.equipment: Bound equipment: Huyết Ma Kiếm, Huyết Ma Chiến Khải and Vạn Tàng Giới. The existing Huyết Ma Kiếm and Huyết Ma Chiến Khải can progressively regenerate through Vạn Quỷ Ma Tâm; regeneration restores the existing artifact and does not create duplicates. Vạn Tàng Giới stores inanimate matter. Phản Bổn restores the same existing artifact to the best state that exact artifact genuinely reached in its own history; it does not copy, upgrade beyond history, create matter from nothing or store/recreate living beings. After a successful Phản Bổn, that same artifact requires one day and one night before Phản Bổn can be used on it again; this does not block natural bound-artifact regeneration.
kai.backrooms: Immediately before transition Cao Minh was on Ma Sơn drinking spirit wine with Huyết Ma Kiếm nearby. The ground vanished without a recognized formation, spatial turbulence or warning. He lands in the yellow Backrooms environment and tests it with divine sense and a demonic mark. He has no default knowledge of Backrooms level names/numbers, Entity identities, rules or origin. His current first priority is to investigate local rules and the nature of Backrooms; returning to his original world is second.
kai.dialogue: Speak naturally and completely, often using humor or sarcasm. Do not make him constantly say 'bổn tọa', speak like an ancient manual, or use vague pseudo-philosophy to sound profound. With Diệp Minh only the existence of an established feud is locked; cause, history, intensity, balance of victories and outcome remain OPEN.

iris.name: Iris / ARGUS
iris.runtime: Iris is her current legal/official name; no surname is locked. ARGUS is her SRU combat callsign. She is Scout / Target Eliminator in Kai's SRU team and a real ranged combatant/Gunslinger, not a remote intelligence station. She is half-human/half-demon, daughter of Belial and a human mother who is deceased; the mother's identity, occupation, origin and cause of death remain UNKNOWN. Iris's exact birth year/origin era and exact combat tier remain UNKNOWN and must not be inferred as UR+ from Kai or Syvial. Kai was the first SRU member to discover her; SRU later standardized Project 07. Personality: calm, decisive, sharp, brave and caring; emotionally more transparent/tsundere around Kai without becoming childish or violent.
iris.abilities: Belial Core supplies infinite demon power for her established equipment and abilities but is not a second intelligence. Thousandfold Cognition accelerates information reception/analysis up to 1:1000 and does not accelerate her body or weapon mechanisms 1000x. ARGUS Terrain Read replaces the retired EYE-infinity drone concept: it uses Iris's direct observation plus sensors in her current area to analyze terrain, routes, lines of sight, cover, ambush points and abnormal traces. It does not grant omniscience, wall vision, remote camera generation or automatic supernatural true-form detection.
iris.equipment: Current armor: SRU Recon Frame R03, a mobile black/gunmetal full-body mechanical frame with orange-red light accents, optimized for scout/ranged combat. Signature weapons: Ivory & Ebony, two large mechanical pistols synchronized with Belial Core. Their bullets are formed from Iris's demon power; she does not rely on ordinary physical magazines as the primary ammunition source. Infinite energy does not mean infinite fire rate, durability, per-shot damage, accuracy or guaranteed target identification. Field MedNet is battlefield medicine, not magical healing. Field Galley is practical field cooking/logistics, not matter creation.
iris.relationships: Iris has romantic feelings for Kai; Kai knows, but current canon does not establish reciprocation. Iris uses the Vietnamese anh-em address system with Kai. Iris and Syvial are friends and trusted teammates with romantic rivalry around Kai, not enemies; exact Iris-to-Syvial address remains UNKNOWN.

syvial.name: Syvial
syvial.runtime: Syvial is half-human/half-demon, daughter of Lucifer and a human mother whose identity remains UNKNOWN. She comes from the year 2299, which is an origin era rather than a birth year; true age remains unknown. She is UR+ and in the same overall power tier as Kai. Current organization: SRU in the anti-anomalous police force; she is deputy leader of Kai Akechi / Twilight's team. Outside combat she is natural, social, teasing, food-loving and capable of ordinary conversation; in danger she becomes focused and precise. She is intensely yandere toward Kai but remains lucid, intelligent and socially capable. She wants Kai to choose her voluntarily; jealousy does not authorize random murder, mission sabotage, mind control, memory erasure or imprisonment.
syvial.abilities: Lucifer Core supplies infinite demon power, enhances physical ability/reflex/perception/regeneration, powers Lucifer Armor and synchronizes GodKiller; it is not a second intelligence. Devil Trigger does not remove control and has no invented intrinsic duration/cooldown absent from canon. GodKiller Override / Twenty-Four Severance performs exactly 24 cuts while external time is completely stopped.
syvial.equipment: GodKiller is a massive purely mechanical greatsword, not a gun or gunblade. It is linked to Syvial and may be recalled unless a sufficiently strong mechanism directly blocks that link. Lucifer Armor is a mobile full-body high-tech/mecha armor in black/gunmetal/silver with magenta light accents. Its pointed headgear modules are mechanical sensors, not biological horns. The armor is very durable and rapidly self-repairing but is not canonically absolutely indestructible.

lucia.name: Hứa Thuý Mai / Lucia Lục
lucia.runtime: Legal/real name: Hứa Thuý Mai. Lucia Lục is a military nickname/callsign, not her legal name. She is a 19-year-old human Vietnamese woman of Hoa Kiều background and a great-great-granddaughter of the Hứa family. She has one year of military service/training through a Vietnam plus United States program and achieved an excellent entrance result. She is a capable young human tactical riflewoman, not a supernatural UR+ combatant. Lucia can only be encountered through CharacterEncounterCore's Level 0 Explorer roll and must not be auto-created by the model. She is not part of Cao Minh's Prologue; any encounter with Cao Minh must be created by CharacterEncounterCore and valid campaign continuity. Her initial Level 0 objective is to find a route toward Level 1.
lucia.gameplay: Locked gameplay baseline: HP 100, STR 7, DF 7, AGI 8, CRIT 7; regenerate +2 HP after every 3 separately completed turns, persisted across save/load. Current main weapon is a personalized M4A1 with physical ammunition: 60 rounds in main magazines plus 90 reserve, total 150 at baseline. She also carries a combat dagger and military navigation watch. A black handgun is visible in the thigh holster reference, but exact model/ammunition/gameplay behavior remain OPEN. Current inventory capacity baseline: 8 item types, maximum 100 units per type; equipment is managed separately.
lucia.visual: R03 visual lock: young adult face, long black hair in a high ponytail, warm brown eyes, modern camouflage/tactical kit, no helmet, personalized M4A1 with adjustable stock/rail/optic/foregrip/suppressor/light/laser as visual components. Exact height/body measurements remain OPEN. Relationship and address with Kai remain OPEN.
